items.headline: Walk-off! Commanders stun the Bengals 22-20 on Monday night
items.body: What a finish in Landover. After Evan McPherson's 56-yard field goal put Cincinnati up 20-19 with 46 seconds left, Jayden Daniels sprinted the Commanders 64 yards in three plays, and rookie kicker Drew Stevens drilled his fifth field goal of the night as time expired. A 1-4-1 Washington team just knocked off the 7-3 Bengals.
items.say: Did you catch the end of Monday night? The Commanders drove the length of the field in the last minute and won it on a rookie's walk-off field goal — Bengals just gave one away. You following any football this year?

links.text: Commanders rally for 22-20 upset (The Athletic Football Show)

items.headline: Finally! The Bucks end a 13-game losing streak
items.body: Milwaukee had dropped 13 in a row — but last night they beat the Raptors 116-111 in Toronto to stop the bleeding. Tyler Herro poured in 32 and Myles Turner added 27 points and 11 boards. You could feel the relief.
items.say: The Bucks finally won a game — they'd lost 13 straight before beating the Raptors last night. Thirteen! That's a rough month. You catching any NBA this season?

items.headline: The Leafs rally past the Islanders to snap a nine-game road skid
items.body: Misery loves company on streak night: Toronto had lost nine straight away from home before storming back for a 4-2 win on Long Island. A gritty comeback, finally a little breathing room for a team that needed it badly.
items.say: The Maple Leafs had lost nine road games in a row, then came from behind to win last night — their fans can finally exhale. You keep up with any hockey?

items.headline: Upset in Doha — Navajo Stirling knocks out Jiri Prochazka
items.body: The one everyone's replaying: in the UFC Qatar main event Saturday, unbeaten 23-year-old Navajo Stirling dropped former champion Jiri Prochazka with a huge right hand late in Round 2. Stirling's now a perfect 12-0 and suddenly a name to watch at light heavyweight.
items.say: Did you see that UFC knockout over the weekend? This undefeated kid Navajo Stirling walked a former champ right into a big right hand — ended it in the second round. You ever watch the fights?

items.headline: Huge Champions League night — Man City-Napoli and Arsenal-Dortmund tonight
items.body: Matchday 5 of the league phase lands today, and it's loaded: Manchester City host Napoli (Guardiola vs. Antonio Conte), Arsenal welcome Borussia Dortmund, and Real Madrid take on PSV. Every match streams on Paramount+ in the US. Perfect midweek European football.
items.say: Big Champions League night tonight — Man City-Napoli and Arsenal-Dortmund are the ones to circle. Those midweek Euro games are the best. You ever watch the Champions League?

items.headline: The 2027 Grammy nominations are in — RAYE leads the pack
items.body: Nominations just dropped, and British singer RAYE landed a field-leading 11 nods, tying the record for the most by a woman in a single year. Rosalía follows with nine, and Ella Langley, Olivia Rodrigo and Phoebe Bridgers each grabbed seven. The show airs February 7.
items.say: The Grammy nominations came out — RAYE got eleven of them, which ties a record. If you haven't heard her song 'Escapism,' it's so good. Who are you pulling for this year?

items.headline: A stacked movie weekend — 'Hexed' and 'Focker-In-Law' both open Wednesday
items.body: The Thanksgiving box-office scramble is on. Disney's new animated witch adventure 'Hexed' and the Meet the Parents sequel 'Focker-In-Law' (Ben Stiller, De Niro and Ariana Grande) both open Wednesday — chasing 'The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping' in its second weekend. Something for every couch and every kid.
items.say: There's a loaded movie weekend coming — the new Disney one, another Meet the Parents, and Hunger Games still going. Classic take-the-family-to-the-theater week. You planning to see anything over the holiday?

items.headline: After the parade, it's the dogs — National Dog Show airs Thursday
items.body: The coziest Thanksgiving tradition is back: the National Dog Show runs on NBC and Peacock Thursday at noon in every time zone, right after the Macy's parade. Last year a Belgian sheepdog named Soleil took Best in Show out of a field of nearly 2,000 pups.
items.say: You ever leave the National Dog Show on after the parade on Thanksgiving? It's the most relaxing two hours of TV all year. I always end up rooting for the fluffiest one. You have it on?

items.headline: It's defrosting season — Mariah is back on the charts
items.body: You know what this week means: the unofficial start of Christmas-music season. Right on cue, Mariah Carey's 1994 juggernaut 'All I Want for Christmas Is You' is climbing the Hot 100 again, like it does every year once the turkey's in sight. Resistance is futile.
items.say: Well, it's officially Mariah season again — 'All I Want for Christmas Is You' is back on the charts. Are you a 'play it the day after Thanksgiving' person, or a 'not until December' holdout?
